rules.design_description: run_refs may be empty; result metrics must remain empty and design expectations labeled
rules.simulation_evaluation: Actual selected software Run, complete or consistent partial result matching frozen RunInputRef; prefix metrics never imply full-window production or goal met.
rules.same_source: All serializers read one immutable EvaluationReport.run_evaluations, its costs.inputs snapshot (r3 owner-sync required), and shared projections; no current-price lookups.
rules.csv_units: split tables; retain project/scenario/run/object identity, base units and unknown values
rules.html: offline browser viewing; filters inspect saved data and do not execute a new simulation
rules.images: current presentation render with scene revision; AI preview never used as runtime proof
rules.project_package: separate .sfproj editable handoff; JSON report is not a recoverable snapshot
rules.scenario_comparison: Option<RunComparison>; one actual initial success leaves null; actual pairs carry typed changes/conditions; no string-only input_changes or ScenarioComparison alias.
rules.report_language: zh-CN; stable identifiers and code remain English
rules.main_comparison: Display two scenarios together; retain additional saved scenarios. No comparison required for an initial successful run.
rules.unknown_price: List missing prices and affected cost conclusions; do not fill zero or claim complete total cost.
rules.selected_observation_window: Use each selected Run.window frozen at execution. Timeline display cropping is not a new report observation window; a different execution window is selected in Scenario and rerun. Compare full metric windows only when equal.

optional_generation_context.rules: actual production metrics only from referenced runs; goals and actual quantities use the same selected unit/scope/window; software timing/FPS only if measured; initial target met may have exactly one run, no revised reference, empty changes/reasons and no comparison; missing/unrepairable conditions do not imply target met

field_usage.initial_and_revised_scenario_run_refs: Initial actual run when available; revised references optional and empty when initial target met or no repair run exists. Do not duplicate an initial RunId as a revision.
field_usage.changes_and_reasons: Empty for initial-success delivery; otherwise record actual changes or named inability/missing conditions.
field_usage.stop_reason: initial_target_met, repaired_target_met, missing_conditions, unrepairable_shortfall or finite_budget_exhausted, according to actual state.

resource_utilization.effective_work_ms: Duration union of actual PhaseWorkInterval intersections with this resource actual applicable Claim intervals; not sum across simultaneous claims. Actual phase role/binding required; missing history unknown.
resource_utilization.waiting_ms: Duration union of execution waits intersected with this resource held Claim intervals; means held while waiting. Waiting to acquire a busy resource is object waiting, not occupancy/waiting of that resource. Unassigned waits remain separate.

csv_projection.option: Each nullable field has <field>_state and <field>_reason (computed_until_ms included via context definition). Null=>empty+unknown+reason; absent before/after on added/removed=>not_applicable; empty string=>empty; explicit zero=>known/0. Prefix value_state is row known|partial|not_applicable; prefix reason is row limitation, not a substitute for per-field reasons.
csv_projection.external_text: text column import; CSV quoting preserves structure, not formula execution; raw content unchanged
csv_projection.row_identity: wait_key=run_id+source waits array index from pinned result; acceptance_index=source acceptance_events ordinal; interval_index=source interval ordinal. These serializer keys do not become new domain IDs and cannot be reused after changing a pinned result.
csv_projection.phase_claim_binding: ResourceClaim.phase_ref从实际phase Claim创建时捕获，非phase可null；不从最终Job.phase_ref推导。
csv_projection.claim_end: ResourceClaim.interval_end_causes:Vec<ClaimIntervalEndCause>按intervals序一一对应；released才是已释放，observation_end/computed_boundary均为开放生命端
csv_projection.comparison_rows: Pair rows carry baseline/candidate input/window/acceptance explicitly; run-specific prefix fields not_applicable when no single Run applies. Incomparable delta/percent unknown with named mismatch; never copy zero.
csv_projection.cost_rows: row_kind=cost_line|known_subtotal|complete_total|unit_cost. Subtotal/total separately per currency; unit_cost adds accepted_unit denominator. Line vs totals never summed together.

serializers.shared_source: one immutable EvaluationReport and shared row/figure projection; no per-output business calculation
serializers.json: UTF-8 Versioned<EvaluationReport>/canonical null; public increment pending
serializers.html: offline index.html/local assets/data; escaped content, static in-memory filters, no network/file-fetch/new run
serializers.pdf: printpdf0.12.8 direct page ops; A4 portrait/20mm/11pt, repeated headers/continuations/page numbers; licensed Source Han Sans CN2.005R; actual revision/time image captions
serializers.display_rounding: ms->seconds, ratio->percent, money2 decimals half-up only display
serializers.professional_detail: One shared report summarizes process pose history by sample count and exact ArtifactRecord.result_ref; all other professional outcome/check/witness/limitation/manufacturing/material/budget facts stay exact. Complete immutable results and all panel poses remain in accompanying project files. Summaries do not change acknowledgment, adoption or old Run facts.

pdf_history_reading.ordering: First rows in the frozen shared-table order, independently per Run; preserve original row ordinal for CSV row lookup. Explicitly label shown/total counts as reading examples, never statistical sampling or production totals.
pdf_history_reading.complete_details: Do not trim EvaluationReport, shared rows, HTML, CSV or JSON. PDF identifies the complete CSV only when selected and exact per-Run JSON source array only when selected. If neither is selected, explicitly state full detail was not included and can be exported as JSON/CSV.
pdf_history_reading.preserved_full_text: Professional outcomes/checks/witnesses/material/budget/rights, order/resource/cost/comparison data and all semantically different Issue fields remain. Object-only repetition is grouped explicitly, original arrays and all selected machine-readable detail remain lossless.
pdf_history_reading.image_metadata: Reference report.json scene pointer only when JSON selected; PDF-only explicitly identifies metadata fields and says JSON was not included.
pdf_history_reading.waiting_inventory: All waiting reason kinds and wait end causes are counted per Run across full shared rows, beyond first examples. Counts are records, not quantities or time. Only resolved means waiting resolved; other end causes retain original boundary semantics.
pdf_history_reading.repeated_issues: PDF groups exact Issue records by every field except object_ref, separately for report missing_conditions/limitations and each Run limitation/cost missing_conditions. Preserve every different code/message/field/blocks, exact record counts, first3 object examples and complete selected-data references; never remove original Issues.
pdf_history_reading.scenario_snapshot: Only the Host-generated serialized ScenarioInput conclusion with prefix 明确选择的方案输入快照： is presented with initial_conditions/items record count and first3 examples; every other input field is kept. Full original string remains at exact report.data.conclusions index; do not infer inventory Quantity from record count.
pdf_history_reading.context_repetition: PDF context table references input assumptions and generation context already printed in full in the corresponding report/Run body instead of repeating the same complete JSON for each acceptance scope. Preserve counts, scope, all other context cells and explicit null states.

actual_render_capture.views: Current exported Project layout; each selected Run frozen layout and actual timeline at its computed frontier; design description uses only explicitly selected compatible saved input timelines.
actual_render_capture.identity: scene_revision remains admitted ScopeR; view.project_revision/run_id/view_time_ms retain the exact frozen source, including older Project revisions.
actual_render_capture.resources: Generated PNGs are report-root-relative files. Their report-image permission does not grant redistribution of original source media or change original asset-rights records.
actual_render_capture.failure: Wrong frame, invalid PNG, cancellation or renderer failure must not publish a partial report directory. Missing backend/frontier/historical design projection is reported explicitly, never replaced by preview or invented frames.
actual_render_capture.Native_status: Candidate68592 actual compact captures/four formats, R12 figure pages2/3/4 and B60 cancellation/re-export verified. Subsequent PDF history-reading patch still requires new-candidate runtime acceptance.
actual_render_capture.framing: Report-only camera frames declared frozen hall/line/device/location bounds using canonical product TRS; saved views and immutable Run inputs remain unchanged. This framing does not invent missing presentation geometry.
actual_render_capture.viewport: Report-only Native CSS viewports: layout720x450; timeline720x320. Public RenderView keeps1440x900. Native validates actual window size, DPR and PNG against FrameReady.
actual_render_capture.timeline_membership: Only the frozen Scenario order/task/supply declarations and actual Run Job/transport/Item history may supplement cursor ObjectsAt for timeline snapshots; 3D membership is unchanged.
actual_render_capture.pdf_figures: A4 portrait/20mm; proportional480pt width/max420pt height; captions retain Run/sourceR/ScopeR/time. Exact camera/LOD/coordinate pointer uses report.json only when JSON selected; PDF-only explains JSON metadata was not included.
